analysis: Limb salinity levels frozen at each circulation, EN4, RG09 and reanalysis salinity

section.reanalysis_sections: 34.5 S (ORAS5 -34.56, GLORYS12V1 -34.5), section fields of paper3r1_section_<product>.nc

method.velocity: record-mean barotropic-corrected profile V_bc of ORAS5 or GLORYS12V1, interpolated onto each source's levels (frozen_velocity)
method.limbs: net transport removed, split by sign, transport-weighted S_N and S_S; F_ovS = -(1/S0) T dS with S0 = 35 PSU (limbs of analysis_paper3v2_en4_depth_test.py)

layers.full_column: all levels of each source (EN4 and reanalyses); not available for RG09
layers.upper_2000m: levels with centre depth <= 2000 m; transport removal re-applied in the layer; RG09 uses all of its 0 to 2000 dbar levels (pressure as depth)

method.averaging: monthly limb quantities, then calendar-year means over 2005 to 2024
method.tests: trend_test (OLS trend of annual means, bias-corrected N_eff, interval from the test inversion); mean_test for window means
method.reanalysis_sources_note: the reanalyses' own salinity with the frozen circulation of the other product is a cross-product combination, not the product's own limb series

rg09.mean_long_name: ARGO SALINITY MEAN Jan 2004 - Dec 2018 (15.0 year) RG CLIMATOLOGY
rg09.anomaly_long_name_base: ARGO SALINITY ANOMALY defined by Jan 2004 - Dec 2018 (15.0 year) RG CLIMATOLOGY
rg09.anomaly_long_name_monthly: ARGO SALINITY ANOMALY defined by 2004 - 2018 RG CLIMATOLOGY

trend_test_lag1_ceiling_n20.note: residual lag-1 above this value saturates phi at 0.98 and the N_eff at its floor
